changeSet.author: archiv
changeSet.sql: create table mandant_vollexport ( id uuid not null constraint mandant_vollexport_pk primary key, status text not null constraint mandant_vollexport_status_ck check (status in ('OFFEN', 'FERTIG', 'FEHLER')), s3_schluessel text, s3_version text, sha256 text constraint mandant_vollexport_sha256_ck check (sha256 ~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$'), groesse bigint constraint mandant_vollexport_groesse_ck check (groesse >= 0), anzahl int constraint mandant_vollexport_anzahl_ck check (anzahl >= 0), erstellt timestamptz not null default clock_timestamp(), fertig timestamptz, fehler_id uuid, constraint mandant_vollexport_fertig_ck check ((status = 'FERTIG') = (fertig is not null and sha256 is not null and s3_schluessel is not null and s3_version is not null and anzahl is not null)) ); create index mandant_vollexport_erstellt_ix on mandant_vollexport (erstellt desc);
